name: infoNet inc.
summary: infoNet inc. provides solutions for website construction in Japan. The company provides website and CMS site construction, system development, AI product development, communication support for shareholders and investors, advertising design and printing, web advertising, operation and maintenance, and cloud services. It also offers LENSAhub, a CMS that supports the future of web communication and combines operability and security; LENSA writer, an AI writing service for article creation; MEGLASS finder, a website access analysis tool; and infoCMS, a commercial CMS. infoNet inc. was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
